evidence_required: Verdict with the condition that would make it a fault and the command to check.

marking.criterion: Not a fault under dense GEMM, because a GPU commonly runs at its power limit
A fault if the current limit is lower than intended, checked with nvidia-smi -q -d POWER (Current vs Default Power Limit)
A fault if only some GPUs in a job are capped (stragglers), or if clocks are far below peers

title: Is SW Power Cap Active a fault?
